title: The Rest of US — Peer circle
description: A small peer group of job seekers who meet regularly for support and accountability. Circles are public so seekers can find them; members are not. Only the organizers are named, and a circle shows a member count, never a member list.

id.description: URL-safe slug matching the file name (circles/entries/<id>.json), usually <city>-<name>.

description.description: Who the circle is for and how it runs. Plain text.

focus.description: Optional focus tags, e.g. engineering, product, data, design, leadership.

location.description: City-level location. Coordinates are the city centre, rounded to 2 decimal places. Never a meeting address.

timezone.description: UTC offset the meeting time is given in, e.g. UTC+1 or UTC+5:30.

tz_name.description: IANA timezone of the city, e.g. Europe/London. When present, it takes precedence over `timezone` so daylight-saving changes are handled.

format.description: in_person: meets face to face in the city. hybrid: in person with an online option. online: video calls, members from the wider region.

time.description: Start time in the circle's timezone (HH:MM).

duration_weeks.description: Planned length of the circle. Omit if ongoing.

capacity.description: Maximum number of members, including organizers.

members_count.description: Current number of members, including organizers.

status.description: forming: looking for founding members. open: running, with seats. full: running, no seats. closed: finished.

organizers.description: Only organizers may edit the circle. Each must be added in a pull request from an existing organizer (or the first one, on creation).

contact.description: How seekers privately ask to join. Use an email address or a form or booking link, not a public issue tracker.

updated.description: Last time an organizer confirmed the details. Circles not updated for 90 days are flagged as possibly inactive.
